copy.tagline_en: Add WhatsApp Business Cloud API channel via Chat SDK

howto.what: 装上后它会:把 WhatsApp Cloud 适配器复制进 src/channels/、加注册引用、安装固定版本的 @chat-adapter/whatsapp,再跑构建和注册测试,并提示你填入 Meta 凭据。
howto.when: 当你要给 NanoClaw 接入 WhatsApp 通道(官方 Meta Business Cloud API),或重跑本技能时会触发;升级旧版安装还会改 webhook 路径。

say.text: 帮我把 WhatsApp Cloud 通道加进来,然后构建并跑注册测试。
say.note: 会复制适配器、装依赖并跑构建与测试

howto.what_en: It copies the WhatsApp Cloud adapter into src/channels/, adds the registration import, installs @chat-adapter/whatsapp@4.29.0, runs the build and registration test, and prompts you for Meta credentials.
howto.when_en: Use when you want to add a WhatsApp channel to NanoClaw via the official Meta Business Cloud API, or when re-running this skill; upgrading an older install also moves the webhook route.

say_en.text: Add the WhatsApp Cloud channel, then build and run the registration test.
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs deps, runs build and test.

say_en.text: I've pasted the Meta access token and Phone Number ID, continue.
say_en.note: Credentials go to .env; existing values aren't overwritten.

say_en.text: Run the whatsapp-cloud-registration test to check the adapter install.
say_en.note: Red means the import or dependency drifted.
